verdict.rationale: Bruno's marketing/docs explicitly state there is no cloud sync, no account/login, and zero visibility into user requests, with no AI training on data—implying no telemetry collection to opt out of by design since data never leaves the local filesystem. This is corroborated by local-first storage of collections and offline-first architecture praised by community users, though no dedicated 'telemetry opt-out setting' is documented since none is needed.
